_: Grimoire's own list: the bosses of every Classic dungeon and raid in the order of a normal run, per wing; runs: each wing is a run of its own. n is the name shown, npc the creature ids (first is the boss), f the flags (rare: not always there; optional: not on the way to the end; oneOf: one of the listed creatures appears; quest: summoned with a quest item; summon: players call it up with something in the instance), note a fact about how it appears, chest a boss chest whose loot is the boss's. Corrections, each with its reason in why: spellList, a creature's spell list where VMaNGOS points at another creature's; spells, spells the server casts that neither the database nor the extraction of the C++ scripts (boss-scripts.json) shows; texts, what a spell does where its numbers or its effect live in the server code; hide, spells such a text tells instead or that only show a visual; schools, the school of what a spell does where the spell itself has another; when, the phase or timer of the fight a spell belongs to, where only the script says it. Texts, hide, schools and when hold for the creatures of their boss only. The data build checks every name and id against VMaNGOS and finds out itself whether a boss is spawned, summoned or tied to a world event.

texts.25865: When he bursts he splits into one glob per 5% of his health. Each glob killed takes 5% of his health away; each one that reaches him merges back in. A burst below 5% health kills him.
texts.25989: Every 30 to 40 sec a toxin cloud forms under a random attacker and stays for 3 min. Inside it: 1313 to 1687 Nature damage every 2 sec and 40% slower movement.

bosses.why: The frost, freeze and burst counts are in the script (SpellHit in boss_viscidus.cpp) and the core (Viscidus Freeze in UnitAuraProcHandler.cpp, Viscidus explode in SpellEffects.cpp). Viscidus Grows only marks a glob merging back in. The Toxin cloud comes from a trigger creature the script places at a random attacker for 3 min (Toxin, 26575, casts it again every 10 sec); the Poison Bolt it throws at that trigger (26601) is only the visual.
